text.config.hungrycows.option.milkabilit:
The amount of seconds that you have to wait for an animal to be feedable again.
This refers to the ability to feed an animal to restore their §oMilkability§r/§oShearability§r.
text.config.hungrycows.category.milkabil:
These settings let you customize which exact items can be used to lure and feed each respective animal.
This refers to the ability to feed an animal to restore their §oMilkability§r/§oShearability§r or heal them by 2 health points.
text.config.hungrycows.option.milkabilit:
Any item IDs added to this list are used to lure and feed §lCows§r restoring their §oMilkability§r or one heart.
Besides this list, item IDs can also be added to the item tag "§o#hungrycows:cow_feedable§r" by datapacks or other mods.
By default, this tag only includes the vanilla item tag "§o#minecraft:cow_food§r" (contains: Wheat).

Any item IDs added to this list are used to lure and feed §lMooshrooms§r restoring their §oMilkability§r or one heart.
Besides this list, item IDs can also be added to the item tag "§o#hungrycows:mooshroom_feedable§r" by datapacks or other mods.
By default, this tag only includes the vanilla item tag "§o#minecraft:cow_food§r" (contains: Wheat).

Any item IDs added to this list are used to lure and feed §lGoats§r restoring their §oMilkability§r or one heart.
Besides this list, item IDs can also be added to the item tag "§o#hungrycows:goat_feedable§r" by datapacks or other mods.
By default, this tag only includes the vanilla item tag "§o#minecraft:goat_food§r" (contains: Wheat).

Any item IDs added to this list are used to lure and feed §lSheep§r restoring their §Shearability§r or one heart.
Besides this list, item IDs can also be added to the item tag "§o#hungrycows:sheep_feedable§r" by datapacks or other mods.
By default, this tag only includes the vanilla item tag "§o#minecraft:sheep_food§r" (contains: Wheat).

text.config.hungrycows.category.sheepSet:
These settings exist for parity as they refer to features that aren't adapted from Sheep themselves.
If set to "
Enabled" Sheep use the feature with the same values set above for Cows.
text.config.hungrycows.option.sheepSetti:
Enabled" Sheep regain the same amount of health as Cows by eating a block of Grass.
If set to "
Disabled" Sheep revert to the vanilla behavior of not regaining health at all.

Enabled" Sheep regain the same amount of health (2) as Cows by being fed an item specified in the "Feedable Items" list for Sheep above.
If set to "
Disabled" Sheep revert to the vanilla behavior of not regaining health at all.
Regrowing Wool from Being Fed Food (Sheep)

Enabled" Sheep can also regrow their wool by being fed an item specified in the "Feedable Items" list for Sheep above.
If set to "
Disabled" Sheep revert to the vanilla behavior of not regrowing Wool by being fed at all.
